criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: All three batches sit in one list under the header — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, one line each, on the single page. Nothing is paged away or hidden.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the board — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it — so a batch is added in place, with no navigation away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: The orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER, exactly as the drawing has it — the board names itself at the top of the page.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The header ends at y=51 and the batch list starts at y=71 — it is the first thing beneath the header, just as the drawing shows, with nothing in between.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The input runs from x=20 to x=1283 and the ADD BATCH button sits at x=1293 — to the right of the input, as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting under the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer 'grout tracker · sandbox build'. The readout confirms no status-line element is present.
Nothing on screen can settle this, but your own suite covers it and it passes.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Your suite checks that the export button renders and that a click handler is wired, but nothing in it checks that the export writes valid CSV with a header row — and there is no export surface on screen to look at. I could not check this one.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange status line beneath the add row reading the mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the footer

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call and not a finding.
There is a footer, 'grout tracker · sandbox build', in muted grey at the bottom; your drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
The list shows three batches (B-1041/1042/1043) where the holodeck drawing had two placeholder rows — content the builder chose, not a mismatch.
No console errors were reported on the page.
summary: The board runs and the three things you actually asked for in the PRD are all there — one list of every batch under a GROUT TRACKER header, and an add row on the page itself. The one real miss is the mix-ratio status line: your drawing puts it beneath the add row, but the build skips it and goes straight to the footer. Persistence passes your own tests; the CSV-export criterion I couldn't check, because the suite only proves the button and handler exist, not that the CSV it writes is valid.
